title: bls12-381-g1-ecdlp: Cheon p-1 limb-window scalar update

claims.statement: For uniform s in 1..r-1 and the public powers A_i=[s^i]P0 for i=1..n at n=2^20, the limb-window Cheon attack in proof.md recovers s with probability at least 39/100. Total classical work is at most 2^118.184540 target-group-operation equivalents, including preprocessing, the four-limb scalar update, batched affine additions, dictionary probes, d-th root checks and verification. Peak memory is at most 2^131 bytes. Preprocessing is at most 2^67 target-group-operation equivalents and is included in total work. Nonuniform advice is at most 2^72 bytes and is included in memory. This is a classical cold attack with no uncharged advice, quantum steps or uncharged oracles. The bound holds at n=2^20, which divides r-1; W is the function in proof.md. No expected-time early abort is used.
